summary: Workflow and script are well-crafted with strong GitHub Actions and Bash practices: pinned action refs, least-privilege permissions, idempotent steps, set -euo pipefail, proper error handling, clear exit codes (0/2/3), good variable quoting. Glob-to-regex translation (lines 129–166) correctly handles **, *, ? semantics. Priority/exclusion logic is sound. However, workflow matrices reference test fixtures (tests/fixtures/{docs,api,tests,mixed,none,vendor}.files) and config/label-rules.conf that are not shown in deliverable — unclear if created. No visible act-result.txt or evidence of full TDD cycle with bats tests. If supporting files exist, both are production-ready; if not, workflow will fail on first run.
